messages:
Tara (People Ops): quick sanity check before lock: do we have final confirmations for reviewer coverage and the fallback intake plan?
Ben (Eng Manager): confirmed for my team. I swapped my Wed 15:00 slot to Thu 09:00 with Asha.
Asha (Manager): confirmed on the swap. noted the 4-min timebox per case in the invite.
forms-bot: Reminder: NA submissions lock 03/31 23:59 PT. EMEA extended to 04/02 23:59 CET. Late exceptions require manager note + approval code.
Tara (People Ops): reminder on evidence intake : if uploads fail, email people-ops@redwood with subject "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + <employee>". we'll ingest manually and record the exception.
Ben (Eng Manager): FYI one of my reports has a 120MB benchmark video. will that be a problem?
Tara (People Ops): large files: please host on internal drive and paste the link in the reviewer comments. if that's not possible, use the email fallback but note the file type and size.
ops-bot: Banner posted in #general: "Calibration in progress Apr 3-4. Expect delayed review responses."
Asha (Manager): last Q: do delegates have the same approval authority for late exceptions?
Tara (People Ops): yes : delegates may approve exceptions but must supply the approval code and we'll log the approver name. if policy requires the primary manager, People Ops will flag during QA.
Tara (People Ops): thanks everyone : publishing a read-only calendar and updating the public slot doc now. ping me if anything changes before EOD.
